messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Finastra SQ came back with a few high-priority asks due tomorrow: clarify RBAC roles (tenant-admin vs platform-admin), audit log retention & proof of export to customer's SIEM, and KMS key custody / BYOK flow. Who can take each?

Jorge Ruiz: I'll own the KMS diagram and key custody language. Quick clarifying Q: they asked if we support HSM-backed keys for Private deployments — short answer is yes, but I need to list supported vendors and attestation steps. I'll draft that.

Priya Patel: I'll take the RBAC matrix + evidence for least-privilege. TL;DR: we have roles: tenant-admin, service-ops, platform-admin, and scoped service accounts with granular scopes. Will attach CSV sample.

Lisa Huang: Audit logs note: default retention is 365 days for prod; we can export to customer SIEM via S3 / GCS with structured JSON lines. Example export command for GCS: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-logs/prod/audit/2026-03-20/*.json ./``` Will include SIEM mapping and sample retention policy text.

sec-bot: Incident runbook for data-plane events: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/data-plane-incident ; recommended evidence snapshot command: `aws s3 cp s3://audit-snapshots/<tenant>/snapshot-<ts>.tar.gz /tmp`.

Dylan Park: Noted a related vuln triage item — runtime CVE-2026-0221 (token cache overflow) flagged by Snyk. Patch scheduled for next runtime deploy (canary tomorrow). Mitigation: OOS patch + rate-limit rule. CR opened: INC-3192.

oncall-bot: Canary alert (prod-us-east-1) at 2026-03-19T22:14Z — elevated error rate on model-serve-3. Triage assigned to eng-runtime.

Priya Patel: For the questionnaire question 'Who has KMS key access?': hosted-mode keys are managed by Redwood KMS service (no raw key access by ops); for Private deployments customers supply keys and control HSM custody. We'll provide a SoD table and rotation policy (rotate every 90 days).

Jorge Ruiz: HSM vendors to list: YubiHSM (pilot), AWS CloudHSM (AWS Private), Azure Key Vault HSM (Azure). Attestation: PKCS#11 support + vendor attestation reports. Note that on-prem installs may require customer HSM cert exchange.

Maria Chen: Can we run a brief pre-call with Finastra tomorrow at 10:00 PT? Need security, eng-runtime, and the account exec. Who's available?

Lisa Huang: I can do 10:00 PT.

Dylan Park: I can join.

Jorge Ruiz: I'll be there and will bring the KMS diagram.

Priya Patel: I'll bring RBAC matrix + sample CSV.

Maria Chen: Great. Action owners: Maria — assemble SQ answers; Jorge — KMS diagram + HSM vendor notes; Priya — RBAC evidence CSV; Lisa — SIEM export sample & retention proof; Dylan — update incident/vuln notes and link CR. Goal: send draft to customer by EOD today.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident bridge scheduled at 10:30 PT for runtime canary — tagging eng-runtime.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll ping the docs channel for a template if we need one. Also including a short excerpt we'll paste into the SQ: ```We maintain immutable audit logs with SHA256 chaining; logs are exported daily and tenant exports are available on request.```

Jorge Ruiz: Adding one more thing — for export proof we can provide a signed manifest of S3 objects with checksums, plus a sample CloudTrail/Audit log slice. I'll prepare a 1-page evidence pack.

Priya Patel: I'll attach the CSV and a short write-up on role separation and MFA controls for tenant-admins.

Maria Chen: Perfect. If any blockers surface, call it out here and we'll escalate to the security review call prep channel.

Lisa Huang: Sending initial SIEM mapping draft in ~2 hours.

Dylan Park: I'll post the CR link and mitigation checklist once the canary completes.
